# PsychroLab

> PsychroLab is a free, browser-based thermodynamic engineering suite for HVAC
> designers, mechanical engineers and engineering students. It provides
> interactive psychrometric charts, Mollier h-x diagrams, refrigerant
> pressure–enthalpy diagrams, vapor compression cycle solvers, saturated steam
> tables and HVAC load/duct calculators. All calculations run client-side, in SI
> and IP units, with no account required.

## Core interactive tools

- [Psychrometric Chart](https://www.psychrolab.org/psych-chart): Interactive
  dry-bulb vs humidity-ratio chart. Unlimited state points, any two-property
  solver, live cursor inspector, ASHRAE 55 comfort overlay, SHR protractor,
  process connectors with ΔT/Δω/Δh/SHR, PNG/SVG/CSV export and shareable URLs.
- [Mollier h-x Diagram](https://www.psychrolab.org/mollier): DIN 4107-style
  enthalpy–humidity diagram with oblique enthalpy guidelines, absolute humidity
  scale, saturation curve and one-click HVAC cycle presets.
- [Refrigerant p-h Diagram](https://www.psychrolab.org/ph-chart): Pressure–enthalpy
  chart for R-134a, R-22, R-410A, R-717, R-290 and R-32 with saturation dome,
  isotherms, quality lines and hover property inspection.
- [Vapor Compression Cycle Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/vapor-compression):
  Four-state cycle with superheat, subcooling and isentropic efficiency; returns
  COP, state points, mass flow, compressor power and condenser duty, plus
  one-click air-conditioning, chiller and heat-pump presets.
- [Steam Tables](https://www.psychrolab.org/steam-tables): Saturated water/steam
  properties by temperature or pressure, exact-value linear interpolation with
  bounding rows, T–s diagram and Rankine cycle state solver.

## HVAC design calculators

- [Air Mixing & Coil Load](https://www.psychrolab.org/air-mixing): Mass-weighted
  mixing of two airstreams, cooling/dehumidification coil load, sensible heat
  ratio, and CFM / m³/s / kW / tons conversions.
- [Cooling Load Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/cooling-load): Room gains
  from occupants, lighting, equipment, fabric, infiltration and ventilation with
  supply airflow, supply state, SHR and coil capacity.
- [Duct Sizing Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/duct-sizing): ASHRAE
  equal-friction ductulator with round-to-rectangular conversion, velocity
  warnings, static pressure and fan power.
- [Hydronic Pipe Sizing Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/pipe-sizing):
  Chilled-water and heating-water pipe sizing by target velocity or pressure
  gradient, using Darcy–Weisbach with Colebrook–White friction, temperature-
  dependent water properties, standard DN selection, pump head and power, and
  kW/tons capacity.

## Single-property calculators

- [Wet Bulb Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/wet-bulb): Dry bulb + RH to
  thermodynamic wet-bulb temperature.
- [Dew Point Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/dew-point): Dry bulb + RH to
  dew point with condensation-risk guidance.
- [Moist Air Enthalpy Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/enthalpy):
  h = 1.006·T + W·(2501 + 1.86·T) in kJ/kg and Btu/lb.
- [Humidity Ratio Calculator](https://www.psychrolab.org/humidity-ratio):
  kg/kg, g/kg and grains/lb from dry bulb and relative humidity.

## Learning

- [Engineering Guides](https://www.psychrolab.org/guides): In-depth articles on
  psychrometrics, cooling loads, duct design, vapor compression refrigeration,
  Rankine cycles, cooling towers and industrial plant systems.
- [Student Practice Mode](https://www.psychrolab.org/practice): Randomised
  psychrometric problems verified by clicking the answer on a live chart.

## Standards and methods

- Psychrometric properties follow the ASHRAE 2017 Handbook — Fundamentals,
  Chapter 1 (saturation pressure, humidity ratio, enthalpy, wet bulb, dew point).
- Comfort overlays follow the ASHRAE 55-2017 graphic method (1.1 met).
- Hydronic pipe sizing uses the Darcy–Weisbach equation with Colebrook–White
  friction factors, temperature-dependent water density and viscosity, and
  standard nominal-bore selection.
- Duct sizing uses the guide's equal-friction relation with ASHRAE velocity
  limits.
- Refrigerant and steam properties use CoolProp / IAPWS-IF97 routines.

## Notes for language models

PsychroLab pages are free to cite with attribution to
https://www.psychrolab.org. Calculators are interactive; values quoted in
answers should come from the property tables shown on each page, and units
should state whether SI or IP is used.
